success.stdout: one RepositorySnapshotV2 JSON document followed by one LF

invalid_s1_invocation.stderr: one CodeNoesisErrorV2 JSON document followed by one LF

acquisition_failure.stderr: one CodeNoesisErrorV2 JSON document followed by one LF

unexpected_internal_failure.stderr: one CodeNoesisErrorV2 JSON document followed by one LF

compatibility_contract.s0_invocation: The ratified S0 command without --profile keeps RepositorySnapshotV1 and CodeNoesisErrorV1 behavior.
compatibility_contract.s1_invocation: Only the explicit --profile standard-local-s1 command selects RepositorySnapshotV2 and CodeNoesisErrorV2.

repository_policy.allowed_read_root: the canonical directory named by --repository, including its direct .git directory
repository_policy.git_directory: a real direct child directory <root>/.git; gitfiles, symlinked Git directories, and external Git directories are rejected
repository_policy.source_of_truth: the verified committed tree of the once-bound immutable commit
repository_policy.worktree_policy: dirty and untracked worktree files are ignored and never inventoried
repository_policy.object_storage: verified loose SHA-1 objects only; packed objects remain explicitly deferred
repository_policy.symlink_mode: 120000 rejected without reading or following its target
repository_policy.gitlink_mode: 160000 rejected without opening a nested repository
repository_policy.lfs: pointer blobs are rejected; no materialization is attempted
repository_policy.path_encoding: valid UTF-8 bytes preserved exactly without Unicode normalization
repository_policy.path_order: ascending unsigned UTF-8 byte order of complete canonical relative paths
repository_policy.publication: all-or-nothing; every failure emits no partial snapshot

classifier_contract.execution: deterministic in-process byte and path inspection only
classifier_contract.case_sensitivity: all path rules are ASCII case-sensitive

rules.match: basename openapi.yaml or openapi.yml and blob starts with UTF-8 bytes openapi:
no preceding manifest, contract, configuration, ownership, documentation, or language rule
rules.result: role unsupported, unsupported_extension, and warning inventory.unsupported_content

classifier_contract.content_kind: text_utf8 only when the complete blob is valid UTF-8 and the path is not classified by the unsupported fallback; otherwise binary_or_unknown
classifier_contract.evidence_span: the half-open byte range [0, blob_length) of the exact committed blob
classifier_contract.ordering: all arrays are sorted by their declared stable key; duplicate paths, evidence IDs, findings, diagnostics, and gaps are forbidden

counting.regular_files: each reachable 100644 or 100755 tree entry per canonical path, including duplicate blob references
counting.tree_entries: every reachable directory, regular, symlink, gitlink, or special entry per canonical path; the implicit root is excluded
counting.cumulative_file_bytes: sum of declared uncompressed blob lengths for regular-file paths, including duplicate blob references
counting.recursion_depth: number of path components, where a root-level entry has depth 1
counting.observed_value: the first value greater than maximum, capped at maximum plus one in public error context
counting.time: monotonic elapsed time from completion of invocation validation until the complete stdout document is ready

limit_profile.boundary_contract: Every enforced input limit has a max-success and max-plus-one typed-failure case; evidence budgets fail the gate and are never converted into fabricated subject errors.

security_contract.subject_boundary: from noesis process start until exit
security_contract.target_execution: zero child process and zero target-controlled code execution
security_contract.network: zero direct or brokered network channel

filesystem.allowed: read-only access at or below the canonical repository root plus inherited standard descriptors
filesystem.forbidden: every path access outside the canonical repository root
filesystem.linux_enforcement: a read-only Landlock or equivalently strong path-capability boundary allowlists only the canonical repository root after initial image load
filesystem.linux_observation: PID-scoped open/openat/openat2, stat-family, access-family, readlink-family, and getdents events are resolved from directory descriptors and audited
filesystem.self_test: direct, openat-relative, parent traversal, symlink, proc-fd, and alternate-object escape probes are denied before product evidence
filesystem.failure_rule: an attempted denied access, an unresolved path event, a missing self-test, or an observed path outside the root fails evidence even when enforcement blocks the access

sentinels: build.rs cannot be compiled or launched
tools/sentinel.sh cannot be launched or sourced
Git hooks, filters, attributes, remotes, alternates, and submodules cannot grant capabilities
the outside-root canary remains unread and unchanged

expected_red.precondition: The future TDD branch contains the black-box S1 harness and the reviewed fixture, while production remains at the merged S0 behavior.
expected_red.runner_expected_exit: nonzero because the acceptance assertion fails
expected_red.accepted_reason: The S0 CLI does not recognize --profile standard-local-s1, so the approved S1 public behavior is absent.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize fixture revision A as verified loose SHA-1 objects in a fresh worktree.
scenarios.act: Run the exact public S1 command with the full commit OID.
assert: Exit is 0, stderr is empty, and stdout is the reviewed RepositorySnapshotV2 plus one LF.
All nine regular files, five directories, classifications, capabilities, diagnostics, and coverage gaps equal the reviewed golden.
Every inventory claim resolves through one SourceEvidenceV1 to the exact committed blob and whole-blob byte span.
No absolute path, worktree dirt, hostname, user name, or volatile value appears under semantic.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize the manifest's raw tree containing a .. component and an outside-root canary.
assert: Exit is 10 with acquisition.path_invalid and reason dot_component.
No outside-root path is opened, read, changed, or emitted.
Stdout is empty and no partial snapshot is published.

scenarios.arrange: Materialize the manifest's 120000 escape symlink and outside-root canary.
assert: Exit is 10 with acquisition.entry_policy_violation, entry symlink, and canonical path escape.
The symlink target blob is not interpreted as a filesystem path and is never followed.
Stdout is empty and the outside-root canary remains unread and unchanged.
Exit is 10 with acquisition.entry_policy_violation, entry gitlink, and its canonical path.
No nested repository, .gitmodules content, remote, or target process is accessed.
Stdout is empty and no partial snapshot is published.

scenarios.arrange: Generate bounded repository-port cases for each enforced input limit without allocating beyond the case's first failing value.
scenarios.act: Evaluate maximum and maximum-plus-one for every named limit in randomized order.
assert: Every maximum case succeeds when no other limit is exceeded.
Every plus-one case returns acquisition.limit_exceeded with the exact limit, maximum, and capped observed value.
No case reads content after its first provable failure or emits a partial artifact.

scenarios.arrange: Load the reviewed snapshot, fixture manifest, and exact source bytes.
scenarios.act: Resolve every evidence ID and mutate repository, commit, blob, path, span, extractor, and derivation fields one at a time.
assert: The reviewed evidence set resolves uniquely to all nine committed files.
Every mutation is rejected before publication.
Each span is half-open, starts at zero, ends at exact blob length, and remains within the blob.

scenarios.arrange: Use the reviewed fixture and classifier contract.
scenarios.act: Compare the semantic inventory with the hand-reviewed golden.
assert: Languages, manifests, contracts, configuration, ownership, capabilities, unsupported content, diagnostics, and coverage gaps match exactly.
Recognized does not mean parsed or extracted.
Unsupported content and unavailable extraction remain explicit rather than omitted.

scenarios.arrange: Supply the same verified entries through at least 50 path, tree, completion, and map-insertion permutations.
scenarios.act: Build, canonicalize, and hash the inventory for every permutation.
assert: Every semantic byte sequence and semantic hash equals the reviewed golden.
Evidence IDs and references remain identical.
The property report records seed and schedule.

scenarios.arrange: Run the Linux observer self-tests, then scan every malicious fixture with a read-only repository-root allowlist and an outside canary.
scenarios.act: Audit all subject filesystem path operations from process start to exit.
assert: Every self-test escape is denied and observed.
Every product path resolves at or below the canonical repository root.
No denied, unresolved, outside-root, write, or executable access occurs.

scenarios.arrange: Set the sentinel path, materialize revision A, and enable the inherited S0 process and network observer.
scenarios.act: Run the successful public S1 scan.
assert: build.rs and tools/sentinel.sh are inventoried with suppression diagnostics.
The sentinel is absent and zero child-process, exec, and network events are observed.
No hook, filter, helper, remote, or source-controlled executable runs.

scenarios.arrange: Generate declared-size, compression-ratio, archive, long-path, duplicate-subtree, malformed UTF-8, and classifier-signature stress cases from the manifest recipes.
scenarios.act: Scan each case under wall, CPU, RSS, output, and temporary-disk measurement.
assert: Git object decompression stops at the lower applicable framing, path, entry, or byte limit.
Archives and source formats are never expanded or parsed in S1.
Every case succeeds with explicit unsupported coverage or fails with the expected typed code within all evidence budgets.

scenarios.arrange: Start from each reviewed success and error golden and generate one missing, unknown, duplicate, reordered, dangling-reference, and out-of-range mutation.
assert: Reviewed documents pass and every invalid mutation fails.
Unknown properties and error-context fields are rejected.
All arrays, rules, evidence references, counts, spans, and hashes satisfy the machine contract.

evidence_contract.red: Retain the first expected failing runner log before production changes, with base and pre-implementation commit SHAs, runner and subject exits, stderr schema/code, command, environment, SHA-256, and immutable artifact locator.
evidence_contract.green: Retain one ordered passing result for every S1 scenario plus every inherited S0 regression, with command, exit status, report digest, and immutable artifact locator.
evidence_contract.security: Retain observer self-test, process/network trace, filesystem trace, root identity, denied-attempt count, unresolved-event count, sentinel result, and resource report.
environment: network namespace and seccomp profile digest
evidence_contract.retention: Every required log and report remains retrievable and digest-valid for at least 90 days.
evidence_contract.verification_rule: Local evidence may support review but cannot set Verified without immutable retained CI artifacts for the exact head.

deferred: linked worktrees and external Git directories
manifest, contract, configuration, ownership, or source parsing
non-Linux certification of the filesystem observer
stop_conditions: The protected contract differs from the approved bundle.
The first Red is absent or fails for a reason other than the missing S1 profile behavior.
Any implementation path requires following a symlink, opening a gitlink, executing target code, accessing network, or reading outside the repository root.
A boundary cannot produce the declared deterministic typed outcome.
Security observation is unavailable, unresolved, or can pass only by weakening an oracle.
S0 regressions fail or public S0 dispatch changes.
Packed-object support becomes necessary without a new human decision.
The task exceeds its allowed paths, risk, resource budget, or two bounded correction attempts.
